items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I played with Wiley(?), Hugh Wiley(?). Hugh Wiley. I played the last one with him.

ctx.x: Continuously. I played with Wiley(?), Hugh Wiley(?). Hugh Wiley. I played the last one with him. That's the first time I played one. And he got on the piano at eight o'clock, and didn't get off the piano until twelve. Then the people bought him a drink, and he kept playing, medley after medley.
